meta.title: clinical-contract | Data contracts for clinical data exchanges
meta.description: Write, validate and check clinical data contracts before exchanging CSV or Parquet files.

landing.visualAlt: Clinical-contract workflow between data consumers, data producers, contract validation and data checks
landing.overviewBody: Clinical-Contract helps you write data contracts. Define the expected schema and requirements at the start of a project, validate the contract structure, then check the compliance of a CSV or Parquet file.
landing.contractBody: A shared reference between the teams that produce data and those that use it.
landing.odcsBeforeLink: A readable and versionable YAML format based on the
landing.localBody: Clinical-Contract is a static application: contracts and data files are never uploaded. Everything stays in your browser.
landing.pythonTitle: Clinical-Contract is also available as a Python library.
landing.pythonBody: Install it from PyPI to validate contracts and check CSV or Parquet files from a terminal or your own pipelines.
landing.closing: Need details about the YAML model, types or quality checks?

pageMeta.overviewBody: Learn how to write and validate a data contract, then use it to check the compliance of exchanged data.
pageMeta.pythonApiBody: Install Clinical-Contract, use its public Python API, and integrate single-table or multi-table checks into your applications.
pageMeta.contractReferenceBody: Build a Clinical-Contract YAML document block by block and understand every supported field, type, and quality operator.
